name: Canaria-Phase4-California-Housing-regression-confirmatory-v1
architecture: same width64 four-block residual MLP as Phase3; first two residual blocks are the replacement span

replacement.learned_parameter_budget: component-wise=256*h; composed=256*h at every grid point
replacement.validation_selection: first grid point with span NMSE<=0.12 and validation R2>=teacher_validation_R2-0.05

numeric_profile.adamw_sqrt_intervention: float32 Tensor.sqrt calls only inside AdamW.step are evaluated in float64 and cast back
numeric_profile.scope: same tested R87 CPU research profile; not universal backend portability

statistics.method: paired model-seed percentile bootstrap; one shared index matrix for all primary seed-level means

decision_rules.integrity: all8 fresh seeds retained; both component-wise and composed validation-selected endpoints required. Missing/nonfinite/malformed/unselected endpoint => STOP_INTEGRITY_OR_CENSORING, no seed replacement.
decision_rules.teacher_quality: PASS iff lower95 of mean teacher held-out test R2 > 0.70; FAIL iff upper95<=0.70; otherwise UNCERTAIN.
decision_rules.composition_budget: PASS iff composed selected budget is strictly lower in at least7/8 seeds AND upper95 of mean log2(B_composed/B_componentwise)<0; otherwise FAIL when integrity is complete.
decision_rules.selected_utility: PASS iff lower95 of paired selected-endpoint held-out test R2 difference (composed-componentwise)>-0.03; FAIL iff upper95<=-0.03; otherwise UNCERTAIN.
decision_rules.overall: PHASE4_CONFIRMATORY_PASS iff teacher_quality, composition_budget, selected_utility all PASS with complete integrity; otherwise report exact FAIL/UNCERTAIN gates without rescue.

test_policy: Teacher held-out test metrics are recorded only after validation endpoint selection; replacement test R2 is evaluated only when each condition first passes validation. No test metric selects budget or modifies teacher recipe.
technical_replication: repeat all8 seeds on a second hosted worker under identical profile and require exact scientific records; technical repeats do not increase independent n.
C: A competent validation teacher may have lower held-out test performance.
The larger dataset may eliminate the composition budget advantage.
A smaller composed budget may trade off held-out R2 beyond the locked -0.03 margin.
U: One California Housing split and8 model seeds are not8 datasets.
The dataset is downloaded through sklearn; array hashes define the tested data identity.
No architecture-universal, runtime, memory, energy or hardware-speed claim follows.
stopping_rule: Run fresh seeds2900-2907 exactly once after implementation preflight. No threshold/grid/teacher-recipe change, seed replacement, rescue condition, cohort expansion or optional stopping after outcomes.
